response:
I'm really sorry you're carrying so much of this. Being bullied your whole life would wear anyone down, and it makes complete sense that those cruel words have started to feel like truth. But they aren't the truth—they're what hurting or unkind people chose to say, not a reflection of your actual worth.

It takes real strength to recognize you need support and to ask your parents for a therapist. If they aren't hearing you yet, try telling them specifically how you feel: "I feel sad a lot and I keep thinking bad things about myself. I need help." You can also reach out to a school counselor, nurse, or a teacher you trust—they can help you access support and address the bullying.

If you ever feel like hurting yourself, please tell someone right away or text/call 988 (in the US) to talk to someone who cares.

You deserve to feel safe and to like who you are. Keep reaching out—you're not alone in this.
